title: Tech stocks today: SpaceX and AMD post quarterly results; investors weren't impressed.

title: AMD beats on Q2 earnings estimates, but also reports massive capex spend
summary: AMD (AMD) reported second quarter results on Tuesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $1.66 (compared to analyst estimates of $1.62), and revenue came in at $11.54 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $11.31 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the breaking numbers, including capex.

title: Dow Jones Futures: SpaceX, AMD, Arista Lead Earnings Movers After S&P 500 Jumps To High
summary: The Dow and S&P 500 hit new highs while the Nasdaq powered higher again. SpaceX, AMD and Arista led earnings movers late.

title: AMD Stock Slides After Solid  Earnings Report
summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported solid but unspectacular second-quarter earnings results on Tuesday afternoon.  Adjusted operating income reached $3.1 billion, with a 27% operating margin, just above the Wall Street consensus estimate.  In the all-important data center segment, sales were $6.7 billion, ahead of projections of $6.3 billion and up 107%, with a 31% operating margin.

title: Even Big Profits Aren’t Enough to Keep Chip Investors Happy
summary: Korean memory-chip manufacturer  SK Hynix  late last month booked roughly $65 billion in profit for the quarter ended June 30, a 13-fold increase from last year.  Hynix earned almost as much money in 90 days as it had in the prior 29 years since its IPO, total.  The reports, though outstanding on basically every measure, still fell short of Wall Street’s sky-high expectations for chip companies.
